_notes.d_model: [128, 256, 512] — Branch B's self-attention and the FFN scale with this; it's the main capacity/cost knob.
_notes.d_period: [16, 32, 64, 128] — keep well below d_model; this is what Branch A's O(d_model^2) conv cost is paid in.
_notes.top_k: [3, 5] — ECL has daily+weekly cycles, so 3-5 is a reasonable range according to the original paper; 2 risks missing the weekly component.
_notes.n_heads: {4, 8} — use 4 if d_model is on the small end (128) so each head keeps reasonable width.
_notes.branch_dropout: [0.05, 0.25] — regularizes against over-relying on one branch; start at 0.1.
_notes.branch_warmup_epochs: {2, 3, 5} — should scale with train_epochs so warmup doesn't eat the whole run.
_notes.dropout: [0.05, 0.3] — ECL is fairly low-noise at daily/weekly scale; start around 0.1-0.15.
_notes.d_ff: [256, 512, 1024] — roughly 2x d_model as a starting ratio.
_notes.learning_rate: [0.0001, 0.001] — lower end (1e-4, 3e-4) is usually safer once N=321 channels are all being updated per step.
